Results.ReviewText: I replaced the manifold after only 3 years of minimum use with the first of the 3 valves failing in year and the second of 3 failing in year three.  This is poor quality.   Furthermore, it was somewhat difficult finding the manifold since Weber apparently does not sell the replacement part.   I purchased the new manifold from BBQDepot for around $100, a lot cheaper than purchasing a new Weber grill.  But, I am not satisfied with the failure of this manifold in view of Weber’s quality reputation and the higher price.

Results.ReviewText: Bought this grill a little over two years ago primarily for the 10 yr warranty, we grill a lot.  Notice after the first 6 months the inner part of the lid was pilling contacted Weber they said this was normal?  Within the last year the burner grates and propane tubing has rusted through, contacted Weber again hoping this would be covered under warranty as it should be.  after a couple weeks they responded,  wanted my wife to re-register the sprit grill again and sent generated automated responses.  After reading the responses I see that there is no way that anybody is going to get anything warrantied.   Auto response states in order for warranty to apply the grill must be dissembled & each part cleaned after every use, a simple cleaning will not validate a warranty. We will not be buying another Weber!
Results.Title: Not a good warranty

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
